prose: Scuba, founded by two former Slack leaders, is building a 'context engine' that acts as a shared memory hub for human workers and AI agents. Their argument: assistants and coding agents make individuals faster but teams still lack shared context and taste (Upstarts Media). Basis: the opening of the article.
highlights: Scuba is a shared-memory 'context engine' for people and agents.
Founders Noah Desai Weiss and Dolapo Falola came from Slack.
Bet: team context is the missing layer for AI tools.
